caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Dec 7 to 12.

If your neck and shoulders feel tight, lower-rib breathing can help: breathe in to widen the ribs, then let your shoulders drop as you breathe out. On the commute, wear both backpack straps and pack the heaviest items close to your back. Calf raises work well slowly: 1 second up, a pause, 3 seconds down. And if push-ups hurt your wrists, try hands on a bench or wall for now.

Scroll back through the feed for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🦘
